tasks.gr12-listening-speaking-t4: Topic: Final oral evidence, revision, listening recall, fluency maintenance. Grade 12 FAL learners consolidate oral evidence, revise listening comprehension strategies, and maintain spoken fluency during final revision. Ask learners to identify key listening recall strategies, choose effective oral presentation techniques, recognise features of fluent spoken isiXhosa, apply register control in final oral tasks, and evaluate spoken responses for accuracy and clarity.
tasks.gr12-reading-viewing-t4: Topic: Final revision across prescribed literature, comprehension, summary and visual texts. Grade 12 FAL learners review all key text types and exam strategies, practise summary writing and comprehension across prose, poetry, drama, and visual texts. Ask learners to apply summary-writing rules, answer comprehension questions across text types, interpret visual text features for the final examination, recall literary terms and devices, and apply exam reading strategies efficiently.
tasks.gr12-writing-presenting-t4: Topic: Final exam essays, transactional recall, editing, time management. Grade 12 FAL learners complete writing tasks under pressure, apply planning and proofreading routines, and recall transactional text format features. Ask learners to apply time-management strategies for exam writing, identify transactional text format errors, choose effective essay introductions and conclusions, apply proofreading strategies, and recognise common exam writing mistakes.
tasks.gr12-language-structures-t4: Topic: Revision of all major grammar points, editing, punctuation, style control. Grade 12 FAL learners consolidate Paper 1 language knowledge including concord, tenses, passive voice, connectors, punctuation, and sentence correction for final examinations. Ask learners to apply isiXhosa concord rules, convert between active and passive voice, correct tense errors, choose correct punctuation, and identify style improvements in sentences.
